x402-api-builder 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Launch your own pay-per-call API using the x402 standard (FastAPI + payment manifest + API keys + MCP-wrapper).
- Includes production-ready FastAPI server template for paid endpoints.
- Automated payments in USDC: customer pays and receives an API key via transaction hash.
- x402-manifest for agent/API discovery (`/.well-known/x402`).
- MCP-wrapper integrates your API with MCP tools (get_signals, get_market, etc.).
- Complete file template and quick start instructions included.
